Many photographic quality regressions combine a tight wall-clock budget with a particular fitted result. Slower or differently warmed runtimes reach different checkpoints. Extra-time runs diagnose this; they do not establish normal-budget success.

Short requests spent the partial-feature winner's refinement reserve on speculative feature initialization and an alternate clearance comparison. Commit 3c8480b2 gives its selected grid the first refinement window.
